remarks: MUltiple Offers. Best offer by 6/26 4:00 pm. So much to love!This South Wilton complex is a 5 minute drive to Wilton Center for shopping, dining, a short walk to the dog park & Bradley Park, Norwalk River Trail, Horseshoe pond is across the street. The complex offers a pool and tennis court. The location of this unit is in the back. It's very private, the front looks out to greenery & the back overlooks the pond for a very peaceful view from all rooms. All baths are updated. Granite counters, new backsplash & stainless steel appliances in kitchen. Sustainable bamboo wood floors in the LR & DR. New tile floors in the foyer & kitchen All windows & the sliders are new. There are 2 ways to enjoy the outdoors:the balcony from LR overlooking the pond, or in the atrium/patio off the front foyer. LR has woodburning fireplace. Both bedrooms upstairs are en-suite. The primary easily holds a Calif King bed with ample room for other furniture. The heated lower level has 3 rooms:a mudroom off garage,+ 2 others to use as you choose.Lower level also includes 200 sf storage room. Main level is freshly painted & carpet upstairs cleaned. The location within the complex, the location of the complex itself and the many updates make this a truly exceptional unit. Owner pays $200 year FEMA flood insuranceSmall leak in primary ceiling. Home owners association is responsilble to repair. They are shceduled to come week of 25th.
